headlines.title: 发改委：下半年物价有望保持平稳运行
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委政策研究室主任、新闻发言人蒋毅在新闻发布会上表示，今年上半年，我国物价总水平呈现持续回升态势。本轮物价回升，对企业的利润增加、财政收入增长、居民就业和增收产生积极推动作用，也有效促进了国民经济循环畅通。展望下半年，随着人工智能等新兴产业的加速发展，产能产量调控进一步加强，市场竞争秩序逐步优化，服务消费需求持续释放，将对物价持续回升形成良好支撑。同时，夏粮产量再创新高，肉蛋产能基础稳固，果蔬生产保持平稳，重要民生商品总体供给充裕。总的来看，下半年物价有望保持平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Prices Expected to Remain Stable in the Second Half of the Year
headlines.summary_en: Jiang Yi, director of NDRC Policy Research Office and spokesperson, said at a press conference that in the first half of this year, China's overall price level showed a sustained recovery trend. This round of price recovery has positively driven corporate profit growth, fiscal revenue gains, employment, and household income increases, and effectively promoted smooth circulation of the national economy. Looking ahead to the second half, with accelerated development of emerging industries like AI, further strengthening of production capacity controls, gradual optimization of market competition order, and sustained release of service consumption demand, solid support will form for continued price recovery. Meanwhile, summer grain output hit a new record, meat and egg production capacity remains stable, fruit and vegetable production holds steady, and overall supply of key livelihood goods is ample. In general, prices are expected to maintain stable operation in the second half.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong Stocks Midday Review: Hang Seng Index Down 0.11%, Storage and AI New Stocks Surge
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 31 - Overnight, all three major US indices rebounded, with the China Golden Dragon Index rising. After four consecutive days of gains, Hong Kong market opened slightly lower this morning; Hang Seng Index opened down 21 points at 25,837, then quickly dipped below the 250-day line, falling up to 235 points to a low of 25,622, before gradually stabilizing and rebounding, briefly turning positive intraday. At close, Hang Seng Index fell 0.11% in morning trade, Tech Index rose 0.7%, with HSI turnover of HK$178.57 billion. On the board, storage concept, AI new listings, and PCB concept stocks rebounded violently; brain-computer interface, electronic components, commercial aerospace, and many other sectors saw sharp rebounds; alcoholic beverages, consumer electronics, and mainland trading stocks pulled back, while autos, paper, and dairy stocks weakened intraday. headlines.title: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时强调 强化政治引领 深化创新发展 高质量推进国防和军队现代化

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes at 27th Collective Study Session of the CCP Central Political Bureau: Strengthen Political Guidance, Deepen Innovation-Driven Development, and Advance National Defense and Military Modernization with High Quality
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th group study session on the afternoon of July 30 on advancing national defense and military modernization with high quality. General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasized during the study that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, we must adhere to the guidance of Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement the thinking on strengthening the military for the new era, strengthen political leadership, deepen innovative development, and advance national defense and military modernization with high quality, achieving the centenary goal of the military on schedule, promoting decisive progress toward basic modernization of national defense and military, and providing strong strategic support for comprehensively advancing national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization.

headlines.title_en: Research Report Insight | Guosheng Securities: Maintains 'Buy' rating for Dongpeng Beverage, actively positions in second growth curves like Dongpeng Hydration and Fruit Tea
headlines.summary_en: Guosheng Securities research report notes that Eastroc Beverage has steady revenue, improved gross margins, and buybacks and dividends highlighting value. In 2026H1, the company achieved net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.867 billion yuan, up 20.72% YoY; 2026Q2 net profit attributable was 1.609 billion yuan, up 15.39% YoY. As the fastest-growing sub-sector in beverages, functional drinks have broad industry space as consumer demographics and scenarios continue to expand, and Eastroc is expected to strengthen its leadership through product cost-effectiveness and digital advantages. On top of the traditional Eastroc Special Drink, it is actively building second product curves like Eastroc Hydrate and Fruit Tea, showing strong momentum. Additionally, Hong Kong listing helps the company actively expand overseas markets, potentially bringing new market growth space. Based on this, the company is expected to see net profit attributable growth of +17.9%/+15.7% YoY for 2026-2028.

headlines.title: 日本央行以8-1的投票结果维持利率不变，将视情况加息
headlines.summary: 日本央行周五将政策利率维持在1%，符合预期。上个月该行已将基准利率上调至1995年以来的最高水平。日本央行审议委员高田创持异议支持加息25个基点，高田创认为形势已进入新阶段，日本央行需要采取灵活方式，以应对物价上行风险以及海外金融环境变化。日本央行表示，将继续根据经济和价格发展以及金融状况提高利率，基础通胀已接近2%，金融环境保持宽松，经济活动面临的重大下行风险和价格面临的重大上行风险均有所降低。在最新经济预测中，日本央行下调了2026财年的核心CPI预期，从2.8%降至2.5%，上调2026财年GDP增速预期，从0.5%上调至0.6%。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Japan Keeps Rates Unchanged in an 8-1 Vote, Will Raise Rates as Appropriate
headlines.summary_en: BOJ kept policy rate at 1% on Friday, in line with expectations. Last month the bank had raised its benchmark rate to the highest level since 1995. Board member Takata Hajime dissented in favor of a 25 basis point hike, arguing that conditions have entered a new phase and the BOJ needs flexible measures to address upside price risks and changes in overseas financial environments. The BOJ said it will continue raising rates based on economic and price developments and financial conditions, with underlying inflation near 2%, accommodative financial conditions, and both major downside risks to economic activity and major upside risks to prices having decreased. In its latest economic forecasts, the BOJ lowered its core CPI forecast for fiscal 2026 from 2.8% to 2.5%, and raised its GDP growth forecast for fiscal 2026 from 0.5% to 0.6%.

headlines.title: 凯投宏观：预计澳洲联储下一步行动是在2027年底降息
headlines.summary: 凯投宏观取消了对澳洲联储下个月进一步加息的预测，称本周的第二季度CPI数据足够温和，足以让澳洲联储相信政策已经足够紧缩。凯投宏观经济学家Abhijit Surya表示，尽管如此，通胀回落的道路可能会崎岖不平。加上房地产行业的低迷，Surya现在预计澳洲联储的下一步行动将是降息，尽管不会早于2027年下半年。

headlines.title_en: Capital Economics: Expects RBA's next move to be a rate cut by end-2027
headlines.summary_en: Capital Economics has dropped its forecast for further RBA rate hikes next month, saying this week's Q2 CPI data was mild enough to convince the central bank that policy is already sufficiently restrictive. Economist Abhijit Surya noted that despite this, the path back to target inflation may be bumpy. Combined with the property downturn, Surya now expects the RBA's next move to be a rate cut, though not before the second half of 2027.
